name: eixoone
description: EixoOne monorepo with shared contracts, API, Firebase, Flutter, and legacy FG-008 validation assets.

scripts.validate:shared-contracts: npm --prefix packages/shared_contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/shared_contracts test
scripts.validate:api: npm --prefix backend/api_node run typecheck && npm --prefix backend/api_node test
scripts.validate: npm run validate:shared-contracts && npm run validate:api && npm run validate:manifest
